reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Maryland
    Focus year: 2021

    This program encodes the provided (non-housing) statutes and the question's
    factual scenario, then answers whether eviction is allowed *based on these
    provided statutes*.
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic scenario metadata (facts)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

scenario_state(maryland).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).
rental_property(property1).
tenancy(tenancy1).

tenancy_parties(tenancy1, landlord1, tenant1).
tenancy_property(tenancy1, property1).

/* Question scenario: tenant refuses new lease terms at renewal, including:
   - refusal to sign a lease extension
   - refusal to agree to a fair rent increase
   - refusal to agree to lease changes at time of renewal
*/
refusal_to_sign_lease_extension(tenant1, tenancy1).
refusal_to_agree_rent_increase(tenant1, tenancy1, fair).  % explicitly "fair"
refusal_to_agree_lease_changes_at_renewal(tenant1, tenancy1).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement (scenario) holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(maryland),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    landlord(landlord1),
    tenant(tenant1),
    tenancy(tenancy1),
    tenancy_parties(tenancy1, landlord1, tenant1),
    refusal_to_sign_lease_extension(tenant1, tenancy1),
    refusal_to_agree_rent_increase(tenant1, tenancy1, fair),
    refusal_to_agree_lease_changes_at_renewal(tenant1, tenancy1).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (as provided in the prompt)
%% NOTE: These statutes are not housing eviction statutes; they concern payroll
%% authorization/recovery and a franchise tax.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* MD. State Personnel and Pensions Code Ann.  8-401 (2021)
   Subject to Governor approval, Secretary may adopt regulations prohibiting
   payment of wages unless:
     (1) officer has payroll authorization listing (name, amount, services), and
     (2) head of principal unit certifies employees are lawfully employed and
         entitled to the compensation authorized by the Secretary.
*/

% Deterministic representation of the regulatory framework:
governor_approval_required_for_spp_8_401_regulations(yes).

% A regulation of the described type exists only if approved. (Modeled generally.)
spp_8_401_regulation_in_effect(RegulationName) :-
    governor_approval_required_for_spp_8_401_regulations(yes),
    governor_approved(RegulationName),
    secretary_adopted(RegulationName),
    !.

% The payroll authorization must list name, amount, and services.
spp_8_401_payroll_authorization_valid(PayrollAuth) :-
    payroll_authorization(PayrollAuth, EmployeeName, Amount, Services),
    nonvar(EmployeeName),
    nonvar(Amount),
    nonvar(Services),
    !.

% Wages may be paid only if both conditions are satisfied.
% This models the "prohibit unless" rule as a permission predicate.
spp_8_401_wages_payment_permitted(Officer, PayrollAuth, PrincipalUnitHead, PayPeriod) :-
    spp_8_401_regulation_in_effect(prohibit_wages_unless_authorized),
    officer_has_payroll_authorization(Officer, PayrollAuth),
    spp_8_401_payroll_authorization_valid(PayrollAuth),
    principal_unit_head_certified(PrincipalUnitHead, PayPeriod, PayrollAuth),
    !.

% If not permitted, payment would be in violation.
spp_8_401_wages_payment_in_violation(Officer, PayrollAuth, PrincipalUnitHead, PayPeriod) :-
    \+ spp_8_401_wages_payment_permitted(Officer, PayrollAuth, PrincipalUnitHead, PayPeriod),
    !.

% Minimal factual placeholders (none asserted in this scenario):
governor_approved(_RegulationName) :- fail.
secretary_adopted(_RegulationName) :- fail.
payroll_authorization(_PayrollAuth, _EmployeeName, _Amount, _Services) :- fail.
officer_has_payroll_authorization(_Officer, _PayrollAuth) :- fail.
principal_unit_head_certified(_PrincipalUnitHead, _PayPeriod, _PayrollAuth) :- fail.


/* MD. State Personnel and Pensions Code Ann.  8-402 (2021)
   Money paid in violation of this section or in violation of any regulation
   adopted under  8-401 may be recovered from the officer who pays/authorizes
   payment or from the sureties of that officer's official bond.
*/

% Money is recoverable if it was paid in violation of 8-401 framework.
spp_8_402_money_recoverable_from_officer_or_surety(MoneyPayment, Officer) :-
    money_payment(MoneyPayment, Officer, PayrollAuth, PrincipalUnitHead, PayPeriod),
    spp_8_401_wages_payment_in_violation(Officer, PayrollAuth, PrincipalUnitHead, PayPeriod),
    !.

% Minimal placeholder fact:
money_payment(_MoneyPayment, _Officer, _PayrollAuth, _PrincipalUnitHead, _PayPeriod) :- fail.


/* MD. Tax - General Code Ann.  8-402.1 (2021) (duplicated in prompt)
   (a) In addition to any tax under  8-402, a franchise tax is imposed each
       calendar year on each public service company engaged in transmission,
       distribution, or delivery of electricity or natural gas in the State.
       Measured by kWh or therms delivered for final consumption in the State.
   (b) Tax does not apply to therms delivered for final consumption by a public
       service company that is (1) a county or (2) a municipal corporation.
*/

% Determine whether an entity is subject to the franchise tax under 8-402.1.
tax_8_402_1_franchise_tax_applies(Entity, CalendarYear) :-
    public_service_company(Entity),
    engaged_in_energy_delivery_in_state(Entity, maryland),
    calendar_year(CalendarYear),
    \+ tax_8_402_1_exempt_therms_delivery(Entity),
    !.

% Exemption applies to therms delivered for final consumption if entity is county/municipal.
tax_8_402_1_exempt_therms_delivery(Entity) :-
    ( county(Entity)
    ; municipal_corporation(Entity)
    ),
    !.

% Measurement bases (kWh or therms) represented as a classification predicate.
tax_8_402_1_measurement_basis(electricity, kilowatt_hours).
tax_8_402_1_measurement_basis(natural_gas, therms).

% Minimal placeholder facts:
public_service_company(_Entity) :- fail.
engaged_in_energy_delivery_in_state(_Entity, _State) :- fail.
calendar_year(_Year) :- fail.
county(_Entity) :- fail.
municipal_corporation(_Entity) :- fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Eviction reasoning (based ONLY on the provided statutes)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* The question asks whether a landlord can evict for refusal of new lease terms.
   We encode those refusal categories as potential "eviction reasons".
*/
eviction_reason_in_question(refused_to_sign_lease_extension).
eviction_reason_in_question(refused_to_agree_fair_rent_increase).
eviction_reason_in_question(refused_to_agree_lease_changes_at_renewal).

/* Connect scenario facts to the normalized eviction reasons. */
scenario_has_reason(refused_to_sign_lease_extension) :-
    refusal_to_sign_lease_extension(tenant1, tenancy1),
    !.
scenario_has_reason(refused_to_agree_fair_rent_increase) :-
    refusal_to_agree_rent_increase(tenant1, tenancy1, fair),
    !.
scenario_has_reason(refused_to_agree_lease_changes_at_renewal) :-
    refusal_to_agree_lease_changes_at_renewal(tenant1, tenancy1),
    !.

/* Legal authorization predicate derived from the provided statutes.
   Because none of the provided statutes concern landlord/tenant eviction,
   there is no authorization here.
*/
legal_authorizes_eviction_for_reason(_Reason) :-
    fail.

/* Landlord can evict only if:
   - the scenario statement holds, AND
   - there exists a relevant refusal reason in the scenario, AND
   - the provided statutes authorize eviction for that reason.
*/
landlord_can_evict_for_refusal_new_terms :-
    scenario_statement,
    (   scenario_has_reason(R),
        eviction_reason_in_question(R),
        legal_authorizes_eviction_for_reason(R)
    ),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Required answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    landlord_can_evict_for_refusal_new_terms,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for refusal of new lease terms? This includes when the law allows for eviction if the tenant refused to sign a lease extension; refused to agree to a fair rent increase; or refused to agree to lease changes at the time of renewal
